_meta.label: Emotional Driver
_meta.instruction: The selected emotion should change tone and framing. It must not change product facts or invent outcomes.

relief.label: Relief
relief.definition: Frame the ad as reducing strain, guesswork, or daily friction.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.definition: Frame the ad as a calmer, more assured next step. Avoid hype.

control.label: Control
control.definition: Frame the ad as restoring a sense of handle on routine or hunger.

clarity.label: Clarity
clarity.definition: Frame the ad as making the plan obvious and easy to follow.

hope.label: Hope
hope.definition: Frame a believable better path without miracle language.

trust.label: Trust
trust.definition: Frame with supplied credibility and low-risk next steps.

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.definition: Frame a start that feels movable in the next 15 days, using only supplied windows.

accountability.label: Accountability
accountability.definition: Frame the feeling of not doing this alone, using supplied support.
